sections.title: Front matter
sections.extract: THE HABIRO RING OF A NUMBER FIELD STAVROS GAROUFALIDIS, PETER SCHOLZE, CAMPBELL WHEELER, AND DON ZAGIER Abstract. We introduce the Habiro ring of a number field K and modules over it graded by K3(K).
